lines.zh: 我这副身子在走廊里挪。
lines.en: This body of mine shifts down the corridor.

lines.zh: 八条腿交错落地，一步比一步响。
lines.en: Eight legs land in turn, each louder.
I move along the Nether's rock walls.
The stone I step on turns black.
I close in step by step, steadily.

lines.zh: 我穿过火堆，火苗被压下去。
lines.en: I cross a fire and its flames flatten.
My plates open and close.

lines.zh: 我从一块岩石上爬过去。
lines.en: I crawl over a boulder.

lines.zh: 我沿着岩浆沟的边缘走。
lines.en: I walk the edge of a lava channel.

lines.zh: 我把挡路的石柱推倒了。
lines.en: I push a stone pillar down.

lines.zh: 我的腿很长，跨一步顶你十步。
lines.en: My legs are long; one stride is ten of yours.

lines.zh: 我走起来地面一直在抖。
lines.en: The ground never stops shaking as I move.

lines.zh: 我绕到那条路的另一头。
lines.en: I circle to the far end of that path.

lines.zh: 我身上滴下来的东西在烧。
lines.en: What drips from me burns.
I cross directly above you.

lines.zh: 我每走一步都换一只脚。
lines.en: I alternate feet with every step.

lines.zh: 我停着，甲缝里冒出火星。
lines.en: I stop and sparks rise from my seams.

lines.zh: 我把头低下来，看着地面。
lines.en: I lower my head and watch the ground.
These prints all over the ground are mine.
I rotate a joint slowly.
The light on me pulses.
I listen to the lava flowing.
I draw one leg in.

lines.zh: 灰落在我甲上，又滑下去。
lines.en: Ash lands on my plates and slides off.
I don't breathe; I have no lungs.
I'm sizing up what can be stepped on.
The quiet here is unnatural.

lines.zh: 你在我影子下面，很合适。
lines.en: You're under my shadow — fitting.
I lower my head; eight eyes find you.
That iron of yours doesn't impress me.
You're backing up slowly.
I lift a leg and consider you.
You don't scream — good.
I'm here; you don't pass.
Back up again and it's the wall.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，撞塌了石柱。
lines.en: One step back and a pillar comes down.

lines.zh: 这一下从甲缝里钻进来。
lines.en: That one came in through a seam.
Hot vapor vents from me.
I shudder once and hold.

lines.zh: 我的腿断了一条，还有七条。
lines.en: One leg is gone; seven remain.
Blood and sparks fall together.
The blow tips my head aside.

lines.zh: 我把重心换到别的腿上。
lines.en: I move my weight to other legs.
Wounded like this, I'm still standing.

lines.zh: 这种东西进不了我的口。
lines.en: Such stuff never gets past my jaws.
You hold it up; I tilt my head.

lines.zh: 我用一条腿把它扫掉了。
lines.en: I knock it away with a leg.

lines.zh: 这味道一点意思都没有。
lines.en: The smell means nothing.

lines.zh: 我的胃口比这个大得多。
lines.en: My appetite is far larger.

lines.zh: 它地上的响动比它的味道重。
lines.en: It makes more noise than smell.
I step on it — deliberately.
Keep it; it's no use to me.
Stop holding it up; it's tiresome.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的腿，弹回去了。
lines.en: You hit my leg and bounce back.
My balance doesn't shift at all.
You've set my plates ringing.
I step over you without crushing.

lines.zh: 碎石从我们之间飞出去。
lines.en: Rubble flies out from between us.
You're lighter than one of my feet.
I tilt my head and look at you.
I don't stop; I keep going.

lines.zh: 这点力道，连我的关节都撼不动。
lines.en: That can't even shake a joint.
I go around you without stopping.
Two sets of legs move abreast.
Her plates shine brighter than mine.
Our head shells knock together.
She runs hotter than I do.

lines.zh: 我们没有声音，只有振动。
lines.en: We make no sound, only vibration.
She has as many legs as I do.

lines.zh: 我们一起压平了一片岩地。
lines.en: Together we flatten a patch of rock.

lines.zh: 她走开后，地上的印还在。
lines.en: After she leaves, the prints stay.
This rock belongs to the two of us.
Neither of us lowers its head.
I pinch it up and glance at it.
It turns to ash in my grip.
Too small; it's lost in a seam.
I lift it and let go.
I press it down at the lava's edge.
I can't reach anything that small.
One foot crushes it.

lines.zh: 它连我一条腿的宽都不够。
lines.en: It's narrower than one of my legs.
This isn't a prize.
I sweep it aside and move on.

lines.zh: 有东西在动，我转过去了。
lines.en: Something moved; I've turned.
Every eye is on you.
There's nowhere here to hide.
I've singled you out.
I start walking your way.
I don't roar; no need.
Your heartbeat is getting quicker.
This ground is mine.

lines.zh: 你被看见的时候就已经输了。
lines.en: Being seen was already losing.

lines.zh: 你在石头间钻，我在上面。
lines.en: You weave among the rocks; I'm above.

lines.zh: 我一条腿拦住了那条路。
lines.en: One of my legs bars that path.
There's a lava channel behind you.
I'm in no hurry; both sides are hot.
I raise two forelegs.

lines.zh: 尘土和火星一起扬起来。
lines.en: Dust and sparks rise together.
I'm one step from you.

lines.zh: 你抬头看，什么也看不清。
lines.en: You look up and can't make anything out.
This is where I should come down.
The ground under us is cracking.
You can no longer move.
My foot is directly over your head.
I bring a foot down at your head.
A patch of ground gives way.
I sweep with a foreleg.
You're shoved into the rock wall.
I bite twice, teeth meeting.
It flips you over.
Another leg follows.

lines.zh: 你躲开，我的腿扎进土里。
lines.en: You dodge; my leg bites the dirt.
Sparks spray over you.

lines.zh: 你一闪，我的腿陷进地里。
lines.en: You flinch away and my leg sinks in.
The rock wall splits first; then I come out.
Eight legs brace on the ground.
Sparks fall off me.
I raise my head to tree height.

lines.zh: 这一带的热气都朝我来。
lines.en: The heat here all flows toward me.

lines.zh: 我踩下第一只脚，地响了。
lines.en: I set my first foot down and the ground rings.
Tubes on me are still dripping.

lines.zh: 我转了一圈，看清了地方。
lines.en: I turn once and take in the place.
Something moves far off.
I walk toward the sound.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的甲，一直没停。
lines.en: Fire catches my plates and keeps burning.

lines.zh: 我落下去，腿撑不住这么重。
lines.en: I fall, and my legs can't hold the weight.

lines.zh: 水一下没到头顶，我乱蹬。
lines.en: Water closes overhead and I kick wildly.
The blast peels a plate off me.

lines.zh: 一根长东西扎进我的关节。
lines.en: Something long lodges in a joint.
Spell-light works into my seams.
Starved to the end, I can't lift my legs.

lines.zh: 雷顺着我八条腿走到地面。
lines.en: Lightning runs down eight legs to the ground.

lines.zh: 下面是空的，我一直往下。
lines.en: Nothing below; I keep going down.
